# Legacy Nails and Lashes

> Nail & lash salon based in Elgin, Texas. Acrylic and dip full sets, 3D nail art, gel manis, pedicures and lash extensions at our new salon on Lee Dildy Blvd in Elgin. Pull up a chair by the rose wall, sip a complimentary drink, and leave with nails you can't stop looking at.

## Services
- Full sets & nail art: Acrylic and SNS dip sets in every shape, finished with 3D flowers, charms, crystals and chrome.
- Manicures: Classic and gel manicures, French tips and ombre, done clean and detailed.
- Pedicures: Relax in the chair with a drink while we take care of your feet.
- Eyelash extensions: Lashes that finish the look, booked right alongside your nails.
- Spa add-ons: A little extra pampering for your hands and feet.
- Packages & parties: Come together: combos, nails plus lashes, and group visits.

## About
Legacy Nails and Lashes started out in Taylor and moved to a new home at 910 Lee Dildy Blvd in Elgin. When we moved, Miriam reached out to our regulars to let them know, and plenty of them made the drive to find us. Walk in and you'll see why people stay: blush-pink walls, a floor-to-ceiling rose wall, white chairs and a sign that says exactly how we feel: Love You Here. Clients call the salon beautiful, spotless and relaxing, and we offer complimentary drinks while you sit back. The work is the fun part. Long French sets with crystals, chrome stilettos, 3D flowers and gold charms, hand-painted Halloween sets, or just a quick mani and pedi. Moms bring their kids, regulars come back every few weeks, and our team works hard to make every client happy. We pamper you with love and creativity.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Did Legacy Nails and Lashes move?
  A: Yes. We moved from Taylor to 910 Lee Dildy Blvd, Ste 110, Elgin, TX 78621. Same team, new salon.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Friday 9:30 am to 7:30 pm, Saturday 9 am to 6:30 pm and Sunday 11 am to 5:30 pm.
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Call (512) 285-5156 and we'll tell you when a chair is open, or send a booking request and we'll confirm.
- Q: Can I bring my kids?
  A: Yes, families are welcome. One mom told us we invited her son to sit right next to her during her appointment.
- Q: Do you do lashes too?
  A: Yes. Classic, hybrid and volume lash extensions, fills, lash lifts and lash tints, and nail and lash packages.
- Q: Do you do custom nail art?
  A: Yes. Bring a photo or an idea: 3D flowers, bows, charms, crystals, chrome, cat-eye, French, any shape.
